name: @absolutejs/agent-exchange-secure-messaging
description: Strict-E2EE request and receipt transport for model-blind AbsoluteJS Agent Exchange.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target=node --external @absolutejs/agent-exchange --external @absolutejs/secure-messaging && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public
